    ONLINE SHOPPING

    How to make online shopping and get it in Armenia

    01. REGISTER AND GET YOUR INTERNATIONAL SHIPPING ADDRESSES FOR FREE

    Your USA address is located in Delaware where there are no additional taxes on purchases

    02. USE YOUR SHIPPING ADDRESSES FOR SHOPPING IN THE BEST ONLINE STORES

    You will be able to shop at any online store using your shipping addresses. When the parcel reaches your international address, you can track its further movement to Yerevan on your profile page

    03. GET YOUR PURCHASES IN ANY CITY OF ARMENIA, AS WELL IS IN ARTSAKH

    You can get your purchases in Armenia in the fastest and safest way. Keep in mind that you can use “LOCKER DELIVERY” service in Yerevan and get your purchases contactless from the nearest location․

    WEIGHT CALCULATION

    For shipments made by sea for individuals, the chargeable weight will be the greater of the shipment’s actual weight and volumetric weight. For shipments made by air and ground for individuals, the chargeable weight will be the shipment’s actual weight, except for car body parts, for which the chargeable weight will be the greater of the shipment’s actual weight and volumetric weight. Details.

    For shipments made by any transportation method for legal entities, the chargeable weight will be the greater of the shipment’s actual weight and volumetric weight.

    International formula for calculating volumetric weight: Length X Width X Height / 5000(cm/kg):
